TASK DESCRIPTION

The task consists of systematically analysing the pynxtools ecosystem to identify and document the individual readers, parsers, and format handlers implemented within each plugin. 

For each handler, the supported input formats, data-processing procedures, unit conversions, mathematical transformations, metadata-mapping rules, and assumptions regarding data structure and interpretation are examined. 

The implemented behaviour is compared against the relevant NeXus application definitions, data-format specifications, and documented conventions to identify non-standard processing, implementation-specific deviations, and implicit assumptions. Each finding is documented in a structured table containing the plugin and handler names, source-code repository, relevant documentation and implementation locations, a description of the identified behaviour, and supporting evidence from the source code, tests, or technical documentation. 

The resulting inventory provides a traceable overview of format-specific processing and facilitates the assessment of consistency, interoperability, and compliance with the intended NeXus data model.
